articles.summary: Magnes Rare Earths, a wholly owned subsidiary of Verde AgriTech Ltd is pleased to report additional head-grade rare earth assay results from the Minas Americas Global Alliance project in Minas Gerais, Brazil.
articles.title: Magnes Rare Earths Reports 10 m From Surface at 0.97% TREO at Minas Americas Rare Earth Project

articles.summary: Verde AgriTech Ltd. held its Annual General Meeting of shareholders on Thursday, June 25, 2026, at 300 Prof. Antônio Aleixo, Lourdes, Belo Horizonte, Minas Gerais, Brazil, and is pleased to announce that its shareholders approved all resolutions put before them by a show of hands. Shareholders also noted the retirement of Mr. Cristiano Botelho Veloso as a director of the Company, in respect of which no vote was sought.
articles.title: Verde announces results of the 2026 Annual General Meeting of shareholders
